numeric_missing_value_handling.nearest_historical_landslide_distance_m_: NaN (no prior-dated match yet) filled with sentinel 5000.0; a companion boolean column 'has_prior_history' preserves whether this was a real distance or the sentinel.

note: Any future inference row MUST be built via app.data.ml.feature_matrix.build_feature_matrix() (or the same pandas.get_dummies category set) and reindexed to feature_names_in_order before calling .predict_proba() -- a mismatched column set/order will silently produce wrong scores with plain sklearn estimators.
